asr.full_text: A new twin brother has been born. He's now in his 90s. But people like his parents haven't met them. So some say she's his sister No, even we have many cousins who got married to her dad's. And here's the reason why she became a twin sister, all daughters of a twin from her dad's family from Jammu and Kandar. There's a boy named Abdull and a girl named Amin who, the Abdullroshid, from Bhohapur, Tanegai, is currently in the government office. The ex-Phatema and Farjano, the female residents of Nayapara village in the north, were also interested. The two daughters of Kakhtalibhgai have got married through an association through the Ghatak. Or through a very limited measure. But the issue will not known to everybody, but it became known throughout the media. I have a brother Jomaj and sister Jamaz, I don't think I can do it. The two brothers and sister Jamaz were blessed by God. I have seen more than these sisters Jamaz, I have spent my whole life in prayer for them. They also received the gift of good thoughts, When I look back I remember not having a wife as before Here, the new daughter-in-law in Suvecha is getting a name from all around She speaks about her new family We have 2 brothers and two sisters We have a relationship like that We will hold this relationship for our whole life It is so lucky to be married so close together We have gotten together when we wanted to and we are happy We now want to go to school It actually is lucky. I think I am lucky. We were happy that the guy who was trying to help us met us. I am now in a position to go and learn and get a good job. Mubalik Kurim, My TV Newsdesk
